title: Women in Medieval Culture and Society
description:
Cross-listed with: WGSS455.
Credit only granted for: HIST495, WMST455 or WGSS455.
Formerly: WMST455. Medieval women's identity and cultural roles: the condition, rank and rights of medieval women; their access to power; a study of women's writings and the constraints of social constructs upon the female authorial voice; and contemporary assumptions about women.
